searchText: anyone knows when exactly this (https://devconnect.org/) is supposed to take place? website just says "1 week" + "April" or did I overlook something? Would be nice to be able to plan a bit, even if I'd love to spend all April in Amsterdam 😛 i believe April 18-22 thx 👍 weird that it's not on the site or in the blog post. i wonder if they expect that might change? agree it feels weird, that's why I doubted if I had overlooked smthg. Probably they fear changes yes, but if Covid situation gets really bad again, a week or 2 is not going to make a diff imo
